items.title: Does Tencent Holdings (SEHK:700) Look Fairly Valued After Its 36% Fall?
items.summary: Tencent Holdings has seen its share price fall sharply this year, and that kind of reset puts the focus squarely on whether the current HK$401.60 level is still supported by the cash the business can generate over time. With fresh headlines on both AI infrastructure access and new payment partnerships, the question for investors is how those shifts affect the value implied by Tencent's future cash flows.
